classification.difficultyReason: Compute the trapezium height with sin65°, then sin⁻¹ in the other triangle, choosing the acute angle from the diagram, with a minutes answer.

content.prompt:
The cross-section of a drain is a trapezium $ABCD$ with $AB$ parallel to $DC$. The bank $AD$ is 3.4 m long and makes an angle of $65^\circ$ with $AB$. The bank $BC$ is 3.6 m long.
Calculate the angle $\theta$ that $BC$ makes with $AB$. Answer to the nearest minute.

answer.worked:
The dashed perpendiculars $DE$ and $CF$ are equal, since $AB\parallel DC$. Find the depth using triangle $ADE$.
$$\begin{align*}\sin65^\circ&=\frac{DE}{3.4}\\DE&=3.4\sin65^\circ\\DE&\approx3.081\text{ m}\end{align*}$$
Then use triangle $BCF$ with $CF=DE$.
$$\begin{align*}\sin\theta&=\frac{CF}{3.6}\\\sin\theta&=\frac{3.4\sin65^\circ}{3.6}\\\theta&=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{3.4\sin65^\circ}{3.6}\right)\\\theta&\approx58^\circ52'\end{align*}$$
